::: {.obsidian-dpa}
:::

State the purpose and scope in one paragraph. Name the processing
activities the agreement covers.

# Processing of personal data

Describe the processing. Name the categories of data subjects, the
categories of data, and the purposes.

# Obligations of the processor

State the processor duties under Article 28: act only on
instructions, keep the data confidential, and assist the
controller.

# Sub-processing

State the terms for sub-processors. Name the approval process and
the liability for sub-processor acts.

# Security

State the security measures the processor must apply.

# Data subject rights

State how the processor assists the controller in responding to
data subject requests.

# Duration and deletion

State the duration of the processing and the deletion or return of
data on termination.
